findings.finding: A debug probability field exists; existence alone does not prove normal-match packet transport consumes it.
Native getter reads GameFacade static offset0x3B4; setter0x6A53800 writes it. This is a UGC debug property, not evidence of outgoing player-position delay.

Native methods enqueue packets; inspected prologues lack the IFix dispatch used by supported game hooks. No corresponding GCommon-MUDPSession/UDPSession/NetworkSession/NetworkClient identifiers were found in IDMAP4 dump.
Transport has receive/keepalive/resend threads and shared packet queues; a correct delay needs an instrumented caller for position updates and bounded flush/teardown.
Global debug booleans exist at static offset0x2. No bounded position-only delay or reliable foreground/background restoration was verified; they are not enabled.

Native reference implements presentation-only enemy holds. Callbacks restore owned, unchanged position before original Player.OnUpdate and PostUpdate, then retain the first displayed anchor while saving current real coordinates. Entity identity, match/local epoch and deadline guard writes. This is not evidence of outgoing packet lag.
